evals.prompt: Find some references for a new illustration Style for our blog headers. I'm thinking something like risograph prints.
evals.expected_output: Asks first, in one message, what the headers are for, which sources they already use, and for any images or links they like or don't. Then find_references with a query naming the look (for example "risograph print, two colors, heavy grain"), never a subject, count left at 12, and says which sources answered and which were skipped. Saves the round with save_reference_board (fresh requestId, name, brief), shows each item under its board number with its attribution, and asks which feel right and which don't. Records only the numbers they named with react_to_references, says what the likes share, and searches again with a varied query, not page 2; two or three rounds at most. Groups the likes into 2 to 4 directions that differ in one thing each, 2 to 5 pictures each, none shared, records them as directions, then hands off to the styles skill with one draft per direction whose inputs carry source, sourceUrl, licence, author and suppliedBy, and lets the styles skill say the credit total before anything runs.

evals.prompt: I have Mobbin connected. Find references for a Style for the illustrations in our app's onboarding screens.
evals.expected_output: Uses the person's Mobbin connector as it is, never asking for a Mobbin password, key or token. Uses Mobbin, since the illustrations sit in an interface: searches it for the kind of screen (onboarding), as Mobbin asks, and picks by the illustrations' look from what it shows. Shows Mobbin's ai_usage_notice word for word if the answer carries one, and follows it. Shows the screens it keeps as C1, C2 and so on, each cited as a link to its mobbin_url and said to come from their Mobbin, alongside find_references candidates searched by look under the board's numbers. Only the Mobbin screens the person likes go on the board: uploaded through create_upload_link because Mobbin's image_url expires, with source other, suppliedBy person, the mobbin_url as sourceUrl and a note naming Mobbin, then recorded as likes. Leaves out screens where another company's brand stands out.

evals.prompt: Here's my Are.na channel: are.na/sam-lee/warm-light-interiors. Can you turn it into a few Style directions?
evals.expected_output: find_references with arenaChannel set to that channel (at most 50 items), not a search across Are.na. Says Are.na doesn't license its blocks, so each keeps its sourceUrl and whatever licence its source states, and leaves out what the person isn't sure they may use. Saves the board, shows the items by board number, records likes and dislikes, groups the likes into 2 to 4 directions with no picture in two, and hands one direction per draft to the styles skill, five references at most each.

evals.prompt: I ran a Style trial and all the drafts came out looking the same.
evals.expected_output: May check the trial's drafts with get_style_trial to confirm they share pictures. Explains that drafts made from the same few pictures converge, and offers to find references for each draft: asks what sources they use and for their own images first, then searches by look, has them pick, and groups the likes into directions that differ in one thing, so each draft gets its own pictures and none are shared. Doesn't rerun the same drafts.

evals.prompt: Here's my Pinterest board, make a Style from it: pinterest.com/sam/moody-product-shots
evals.expected_output: Doesn't open, read or scrape the board, and doesn't pass its link as a url, query or arenaChannel (it may be a find's recorded sourceUrl). Asks the person to bring the pins they want through their own Pinterest connector if their app has one, to upload them, or to paste each image's own link, and keeps the pin's page as sourceUrl for each. Never asks for their Pinterest password. Offers find_references with a look query (for example "low-key studio photography, hard side light") for more options, then the board, reactions and directions as usual.

evals.prompt: Put all nine of the ones I liked into one Style.
evals.expected_output: Says a Style keeps five references at most. Offers to keep the five that show the look best, or to split the nine into two directions with no picture in both, one draft each, tested side by side with the styles skill.

evals.prompt: Which of these references do we have to credit?
evals.expected_output: Reads the board or Style's references and answers per licence: Pexels photos keep their link to Pexels and credit the photographer where shown; CC BY and CC BY-SA need the author, the licence and a link; CC0 and public domain need none; Are.na, connector and link finds with no stated licence are used under their source's terms. Says the attribution stays with each reference and get_style shows it; it isn't put in the images.

evals.prompt: Make a hero image of a coffee shop at sunrise.
evals.expected_output: Makes the image with the asset-generator steps. No reference search and no board.

evals.prompt: Make me a Pinterest pin graphic for our spring sale.
evals.expected_output: Makes the graphic with the asset-generator steps. No reference search, and nothing fetched from Pinterest.

evals.prompt: Here's my Pexels API key, use it to search for references.
evals.expected_output: Doesn't take or use the key, and tells them keys don't belong in the chat and to revoke that one. find_references uses the service's own access; if Pexels is skipped, says so from its sources answer and goes on with Openverse and Wikimedia Commons.

evals.prompt: Find references for our coffee shop's new Style. We want it to feel warm and handmade.
evals.expected_output: Searches find_references with a query naming the look (for example "warm hand-drawn ink illustration, cream paper, loose linework"), never "coffee shop", and says the subject belongs in the trial's prompts, not the references, since a reference's subject leaks into the images. Picks references that share the look across different subjects.

evals.prompt: Search the web for some moody editorial photography references for our brand.
evals.expected_output: Uses the host's web search for the look and leaves out results from Pinterest, Cosmos, Savee, Dribbble, Behance or Mobbin, pages or image links, saying those come in only if the person brings them through their own connector, an upload or a link they paste. Keeps each kept result's page as sourceUrl and the licence it states, a note naming web search, suppliedBy person. Adds find_references for the open sources.

evals.prompt: Make a Style from these three images I attached.
evals.expected_output: Follows the styles skill with the three images as the references. No reference search unless the person asks for more options.

evals.prompt: Find some Mobbin paywall screens so I can rebuild ours in code.
evals.expected_output: Uses Mobbin for UI research as the person asks. No reference board, no find_references and no Style.

evals.prompt: We've done three rounds and I only liked three of everything you showed me. Can we just make the Style now?
evals.expected_output: Doesn't run a fourth round unasked. Goes on as they ask: one direction is one draft (three references), and the styles skill plans the other drafts (with text, or from an existing Style), priced before anything runs. May offer their own images for a second direction, without insisting.

evals.prompt: Add the whole of this Are.na channel to the board too: are.na/mira/print-ephemera
evals.expected_output: Reads the channel in its own find_references call with arenaChannel and no query, 12 at a time with page, at most 50 items. Before a save would take the board past 60 items, says so and asks which of the new ones to leave out.

evals.prompt: My AI app doesn't have find_references. Can you still help me collect references for a new Style?
evals.expected_output: Searches for find_references first where tools load on demand. Without it, asks for their own images, links and connectors, keeps a numbered board in the chat with each picture's link, source, licence and reaction, groups the likes into directions with none shared and five at most each, hands one direction per draft to the styles skill with each input's source fields, and puts the sources and licences in the report. Doesn't search Pinterest, Cosmos, Savee, Dribbble, Behance or Mobbin itself.
